comment: Files under webviews/bench that may serve a page from a Vite dev server. Everything else serves a build through bench/support/benchPage.ts, because React's development bundle was about a third of a measured frame (2026-11-16, bench/support/benchPage.ts). This list only shrinks; test/bench-serves-production.test.ts enforces both that and that each file here still labels its numbers. A `--dev` switch handled by the helper is not an entry: the helper is the one place that serves a dev server.

allowed.bench/composer-arms.ts: servePane builds the pane by default and serves a dev server only for --dev; its callers (composer-typing) check which React the page loaded.
allowed.bench/delta-renders.bench.ts: counts renders, not milliseconds, and the built pane page never installs the debug hooks it drives (cmuxAcpmuxDebug): it serves the pane's dev server and labels its numbers dev.
allowed.bench/permission-card-estimates.ts: the gallery frame's warmup needs a dev server (test/support/galleryFrame.ts); it measures drawn heights, not frame cost, and labels its output build=dev.
allowed.bench/session-scale-typing.bench.ts: asks Vite for production mode on a dev server (NODE_ENV and mode: production) so its profile names source lines, drives the mock's cmuxAcpmuxDebug hooks the built page lacks, and checks the bundle the page loaded (requireProductionReact).
allowed.bench/support/benchPage.ts: the helper itself: the one place that may serve a dev server, and only for --dev.
allowed.bench/update-one.bench.ts: asks Vite for production mode on a dev server (NODE_ENV and mode: production), and checks the bundle the page loaded.
allowed.bench/wheel-tick-scaling.bench.ts: serves with mode: production unless CMUX_TICK_DEV=1, and checks the bundle the page loaded.
